title: Extend version-1 batch editing with grouping metadata
description: Extend batch JSON version 1, flat-file batch application, export input construction, patch detection, strict property validation, null clearing, stale-update checks, and rollback coverage for issueId, project, milestone, version, featureId, and feature. Preserve imports whose rows omit the new fields and distinguish stable featureId from display feature.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented version-1 JSON batch support for issueId, project, milestone, version, featureId, and feature with strict property validation, OptionalString omission/null-clear semantics, stable wire ordering, and featureId/feature separation. Flat-file BatchUpdate now applies and trims all six fields, includes them in mutable/no-op detection and journal recovery snapshots, while export input construction carries them through. Added round-trip/null/omission/export/set-clear/no-op/stale/rollback coverage and updated batch contract text. Verification passed: go test ./... -count=1; go test -tags=wtp_fault_injection ./internal/provider/flatfile; go test -race ./internal/batchjson ./internal/batchexport ./internal/provider/flatfile; go vet ./...; ./scripts/verify.sh commit; gofmt; git diff --check.
